Subject: Feedback on Recent Stay - Exceptional Service

Dear Hotel Manager,

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service I received during my recent stay at your hotel. From the moment I arrived until my departure, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction.

I would like to specifically highlight the efforts of [Employee Name 1] at the front desk, who was incredibly welcoming and efficient during check-in, and [Employee Name 2] in housekeeping, who maintained the room to an impeccable standard. Their attentiveness and professionalism truly made my stay memorable.

Given the high quality of service and the warm hospitality shown by your team, I would not hesitate to recommend your hotel to my peers and colleagues. I look forward to the possibility of staying with you again in the future.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
